meta.name: The Raincoat Killer Chasing a Predator in Korea
meta.description: In the early 2000s, Yoo Young-chul hammered his victims to death and cast fear across Seoul. This docuseries recounts the hunt for a prolific killer.

videos.title: New Breed of Killer
videos.overview: Violent killings target wealthy victims around the city. Matching footprints found at each scene suggest a serial murderer on the loose.

videos.title: Killing Grounds
videos.overview: A report about missing sex workers leads to Yoo Young-chul's arrest. Under interrogation, he confesses, but detectives aren't sure what to believe.

videos.title: The Hammer Comes Down
videos.overview: As Yoo's victims are found buried and mutilated, a media storm descends upon the case. In need of tangible evidence, police head to his apartment.
